fusions.name: Springing Kick
fusions.desc: A leaping kick on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dropped From Height
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles to an enemy and lands with your full weight, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cleared the Rail
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. You leap 4 tiles forward as you use it.

fusions.name: Springloaded Bulk
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
